newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans called to open one to two cents up.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans called to open one to two cents up.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures were called to open one to two cents per bushel higher on a "respectable" soybean number in USDA's weekly export sales report, traders said.
USDA early Thursday said U.S. net export sales of soybeans during the week ended April 24 totaled 383,300 tonnes, within the range of trade expectations for 350,000 to 450,000 tonnes.
News an Owensboro, Kentucky grain company has switched most of its optional purchases of soybeans to U.S. origin also was supportive. The firm had been expected to import additional soy from Brazil.
CBOT's Project A overnight trend for soybeans was 2-1/4 cents higher to two cents lower.
